answer.new_information: NN, Inc. announced in late June 2026 that it is adding 47 machine centers for liquid cooling production at its Wuxi, China plant for NVIDIA AI data center racks, repurposing legacy automotive capacity. The company says 100% of the new capacity is pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards, and targets US$80-90 million of accretive new business in 2026. No capex, unit output, or revenue-per-machine figure is given, so the expansion cannot yet be sized against group revenue. The 2026 business target is a company target, not a result, and does not match a full-year revenue or earnings question. The Russell Microcap Value Index removal is a separate fact from a finance.yahoo.com item. The 2028 revenue and earnings figures ($485.5M/$47.9M narrative, $489.5M/$48.3M unnamed analysts) are narrative and rumour projections, not company guidance, and carry no period or definition mapping to a stored question.
answer.new_question: What is the capex, unit output and revenue contribution of the 47 machine centers at the Wuxi plant, and does NN's filing or customer disclosure confirm the 100% pre-sold claim and the US$80-90 million 2026 new-business target?
